container.description: Wide container with generous horizontal padding to give parallax elements room to breathe off-screen.

depth-stage.description: Full-viewport stage with z-index layering system. Overflow visible for parallax elements.

feature-3col.description: 3-col feature grid. First card can span 2 rows for alternating height depth effect.

two-col-deep.description: Asymmetric split 1.2:1 — slight tension creates implied depth between columns.

stats-4col.description: 4-column stats grid. Each stat reads as a separate depth plane.

floating-cards.description: Cards positioned within relative stage container. Hover lifts individual cards toward viewer.

visual.description: 72px fixed nav floating above depth layers. Background transparent initially, glassmorphic on scroll.
100vh+ stage with 3 absolute-positioned parallax layers beneath centered hero content.
3-col grid within container. Cards at different apparent depths via box-shadow.
Full-width dark band. 4 equally spaced stat columns.
3 steps with offset decorative shapes. Each step has implied z-depth via visual offset.

_source: custom grid for strata-drift parallax depth system
_twist: Depth-aware grid design — container 1440px/60px padding, depth stage full-viewport with explicit z-layers, asymmetric two-col for depth tension
